ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: A shimmering mirage is the appearance of water produced by heat over dry ground.
EvidenceBody: The Collected Essentials compares Xuefeng’s repeated journeys to a thirsty deer chasing a mirage. Other Chan records list the mirage with illusion or put waves on it. The thirsty-deer clause supplies the ordinary visual mistake; the shorter formulas show how widely the image is redeployed without explaining it each time.

DraftEvidence.ZenBend: The thirsty deer chasing the apparent water is the explicit control for the Chan comparison.
DraftEvidence.CounterexampleOrLimit: Only the X64 witness states thirst and pursuit; those predicates are not attributed to Yongming or to every occurrence.
